name: BACH_0359
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (95%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Invasive risk is 5% [F1] with full model and neighbor agreement at routine tier 4 (ER stain drafted).

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 95%, Invasive 5%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong InSitu call; low risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th percentile OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | High reliability; atypical vs training |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (87%–88% similarity) [F5]; Invasive contrast 82% | All 5 nearest neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest protective score (-0.74) [F2]; 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Score -0.63 [F3], but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 2) · context · Above-typical TIL score (-0.35) [F4]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 2, 6) · ↓ invasive · Lowers invasive score (-0.33); 12/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Nuclear size and immune proximity** (regions 3, 4, 5) · context · 0th-percentile nuclear area (48 µm²) [F7]; 92nd-percentile TIL proximity [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal stromal invasion exists in high-risk region 4 (71% risk) or regions 0 (24%), 11 (18%), and 5 (14%).
- High OOD score (94th percentile) and unreliable normal-lobule concept (0/20) mask similarity to invasive contrast BACH_0134 (82%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 5**: Inspect highest-risk region 4 (71% risk) and dense neoplastic nuclei (111, 130) for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 0, 3, 7, 11**: Verify benign stroma, discount unreliable lobule calls, and exclude invasion in regions 0, 11.
3. **Regions 1, 2, 6**: Confirm atypical cells remain confined within ducts and review drafted ER stain for DCIS.
